text:
The fluffy things in the sky that rain comes from are clouds.

The mood conveyed in the text is wistful, cozy, and serene. This atmosphere contributes to the narrative by emphasizing a sense of peaceful transition and nostalgia. By describing the park as a "festival of colors" and highlighting the slowing down of the world, the text invites the reader to appreciate the beauty of change rather than fear it. The "cozy promise of the coming winter" suggests comfort and anticipation, framing the autumn season not as an end, but as a gentle, beautiful prelude to rest.
